journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.ritual_c: The small circle: eight chalk lines around the altar, nothing else. The binding circle: a 5x5 chalk square with a lit candle on each corner. The blood circle is the same square drawn in blood chalk.

The great circle is the one for summonings: a ring of blood chalk nine wide, with six lit black candles inside it. The void circle is a ring of the same size broken by crying obsidian at its four points, with four black candles close around the altar.
There is one more circle, drawn only around four old stones under the Cage in Hell. If you ever need it, you will know.
Blood chalk: four chalk and a demon's blood
Chalk, blood chalk, black candle, crying obsidian
Every rite starts with an altar: polished blackstone bricks, a gold ingot and a candle. Set it down, and draw the circle the rite asks for around it, on the same level, with chalk lines and candles lit where it wants them.

Lay the offerings on the altar one at a time, then light the rite with what it asks for, flint and steel more often than not. Some rites want the night, some the day, some a certain place. The rite takes its mana up front.

If the circle is wrong, red sparks mark the first bad block. Once it is burning, never smudge a line or snuff a candle: the circle breaks, lightning falls, it burns you, and something comes through that should not.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.rival_hu: Other hunters work these roads too: in a leather jacket, a flannel shirt or a long coat, with a sawn-off shotgun loaded with rock salt, a machete and a flask of holy water. To a human they are friends, and they will help you against demons. To an angel or a demon they are death: they come by night, shoot from range, close in with the machete and throw holy water at whatever has black eyes.
What they carry: salt, holy water, and once in a while a bullet for the Colt.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.rubys_kn: An iron sword, two demon blood and a hellfire ember on the altar of a blood circle. It cuts demons deeper than steel should.
A demon slain with it always bleeds: the blood is yours every time, smoke or no smoke. Cold iron, too, so it scatters a ghost. Later it is the key to something worse.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.runes.0: A blank rune is smooth stone, chalk and Enochian ink. Carve it at a small circle: the offerings on the altar, the blank in your hand to light it.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.runes.1: For blades: Edge cuts deeper (a tenth of the blade's damage, at least a point and a half), Ember sets alight, Frost slows, Leech heals you from what you deal, Swiftness quickens your swing. For catalysts: Resonance makes spells cheaper and harder, Focus brings them back faster, Echo makes them repeat now and then. Sanctity fits anything and makes every blow holy.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.runes.2: Two runes come only from the great ones. Void, from what the Darkness leaves, carved at night: it drinks the light, and only a tier IV weapon will take it. Hymn, from the Chorus's shards: every fourth blow or spell rings out again as holy light.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.salt.0: Salt is your first friend. Rock salt shows up in the stone like any ore, deeper as deepslate. No ore nearby? Boil a bucket of water dry in a furnace.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.salt.1: Pour it on the ground as a line. You can walk over it; a demon cannot. It is a wall to them, solid as stone, and they will walk the long way round rather than test it. A ghost cannot cross it either.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.salt.2: Salt will not stop the great ones. Nothing you pour on the floor holds a boss. Keep a stack on you anyway: the exorcism, the binding, the bones of a restless grave and half the bowl spells want it.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.salt.cap: Rock salt, in stone and deepslate
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.salt_and: A lonely graveyard, one to three graves on flat dry ground, headstones and mounds of grave soil. Only one of them is restless. Its bones lie two blocks under the end of the mound by the headstone.

Dig the soil and the dirt under it until the bones are bare; while the spirit is restless, they will not break. Salt them. Then set them alight with flint and steel or a fire charge. The ghost goes with them, for good. A Banishing does the same from the bowl.
One grave in each yard hides a chest under the foot of its mound. Grave dirt from the mounds goes into hex bags and darker work.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.seraph_w: Six wings, what is left of the Broken Chorus when it is silenced. Worn on the back (Curios), they rest, fold when you crouch, and open wide when you fall.
They will not carry you anywhere. They are only for show, and what a show.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.shapeshi: It wears somebody else: a villager at the edge of town, or, on a case, the face of a hunter you know. In its borrowed skin it shrugs off most of what you do to it.
Weakness: silver, or a true sight (Second Sight, or the Spellwright's Spectacles), shows it for what it is. Found out, its skin sloughs off and it takes every blow in full.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.sigil_ef: The effects are what the spell does. You cannot draw the same one twice in a spell.

Smite is holy force, twice as hard on demons and the dead. Hellfire burns flesh and a pinch of sulfur. Frost slows, freezes, and turns still water to ice. Mend closes wounds and smothers flames. Repel throws the target away from you. Reveal strips invisibility, outlines what it touches and unmasks illusions.

Two are a hunter's sigils. Exorcise is agony to a demon, and casts a trapped one out entirely; it burns salt. Bind holds a demon as a devil's trap would and hobbles anything else; it burns demon blood.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.sigil_fo: A spell is a form, up to three effects and up to three modifiers. The form is how it reaches the world.

Touch takes whatever is within arm's reach; a helpful spell with nothing there falls back on you. Bolt is thrown and flies straight until it hits something. Burst is a pulse outward from you. Ward is a circle at your feet that keeps working and stops hostile projectiles.
Touch and Bolt are cheap and quick. Burst and Ward cost more and your hand needs longer to recover. Ward is the harder sigil to come by, and the one you will want when something big starts to glow.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.sigil_mo: Modifiers bend a spell and multiply its cost. Empower makes the effects stronger. Extend makes them last longer and reach further. Widen spreads them over an area.
Echo makes the spell repeat itself a moment later. It is written in a hand no one can follow unless they have been touched by grace. Lucifer carries a page of it.
The Scriptorium shows the cost of a spell as you build it. Watch it: three modifiers on a Burst will empty you in one cast.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.sigil_pa: Demons carry scraps of their masters' grimoires. Kill one and now and then a torn sigil page falls out of it; occultists carry them far more often than the black-eyed brawlers. Read a page to learn its sigil for good.
Some pages are written in the third tier, in a hand that burns your eyes. Keep them. Once you have taken in an archangel's grace, they will read like anything else.
The Scriptorium keeps an encyclopedia of the sixteen sigils: the ones you know, and the shapes of the ones you do not.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.silver_m: Three iron ingots, a salt and a holy water in a small circle. Cheap, and made for one thing.
Strikes from behind are double criticals, and a kill from behind takes the head. Get behind them.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.spell_bo: Older than sigils and slower: witchcraft, the way Bobby did it. Five copper ingots and a gold one make the bowl. Set it on solid ground.

Pour in up to four bottles and drop in up to eight ingredients, nothing spare: the mix has to be exactly what the spell asks for. Light it with flint and steel or a fire charge, then speak the Latin before the fire dies. Typing errors cost time; accents and spaces do not matter.
A mix no spell answers to blows up in your face: black smoke, a burn, something nasty for a while, and everything in the bowl is lost. Words you never learned do nothing at all.
Sneak with empty hands to lift the bowl, contents and all. It takes both hands, and it spills if you jump, fall or get hit. Put in your pack, it keeps everything.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.spell_pa: You cannot cast what you do not know the words to. Loose pages with a spell written out, Latin and all, turn up in old graves and forgotten chests, and demons carry them: occultists more often than the black-eyed kind.
A master librarian will sell you one for emeralds and a book. And a crossroads demon who comes back angry always has one on it.
Read a page to learn its spell, with every recipe for it; the page is used up. Once you know a spell, this journal keeps its recipes for you.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.spell_sc: Any spell you can compose you can write out in full on a scroll: a sheet of paper and a vial of Enochian ink each. The Scriptorium writes them in batches if you have the paper and ink for it.
A scroll is read aloud once and burns up. Anyone can read one, sigils known or not, and it costs half the mana the spell would. Hand them to whoever hunts with you.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_arse: Every blade and catalyst worth carrying is forged by ritual, not at a crafting table, and each has a tier, from I to IV, and room for one to three runes. The tier sets what graving them costs.
Catalysts are held opposite a grimoire, in the other hand, and change your spells; alone, they have a spell of their own. The heavier weapons are swung by charging: hold use, then let go.
Holy weapons count as holy wherever they land. That matters more than their edge against the things at the end of this book.
None of them, as forged, is enough for the great enemies. Each can be ascended at the Hellforge with the shards those enemies leave, tier by tier, up to V (see Ascension).
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_bunk: Out in open country, three to five thousand blocks from the world's heart, a little stone hut sits on a hillside that nobody looks at twice. Behind its steel door, iron stairs go down into the Men of Letters' bunker. Henry's map marks it; no compass will.

Only the Bunker Key opens the vault door. Below: the war room with its lit map table, the library with its research desks and archive shelves, a lab, a dungeon with a devil's trap painted on the floor, an armoury, a garage and the dormitories. Its desks, its door and its table yield only to members.
The war room and the library
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_cage: At the heart of Hell, at its very centre, the Pit falls sheer to the lava sea. Over it, on its chains, hangs the Cage, and under the Cage an island with a dais and four old stones.
Lucifer waits inside, in chains, head bowed. Now and then he looks up at whoever has come so far. Nothing can touch him while the Cage is shut.
The iris in its floor opens only for the four rings and the Key. When it does, he comes down.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_colt: A Paterson revolver, 1836, five chambers. Samuel Colt made it for one job. There's nothing this gun can't kill. Lucifer carries it, loaded, and leaves it when he falls.

One round kills any living thing outright: any demon, monster, shade, echo or illusion, any beast. Not a hunter (unless the server allows it), and not archangels or anything above them. Against a great enemy it strikes a twentieth of its full strength that no armour blunts (the Author, far less), though it will not carry them past one of their turning points. Use to fire; sneak-use or the reload key seats one round at a time.
The rounds cannot be crafted. Once you have held the Colt, forge them by night in a blood circle, eight at a time. A few lie in the Hymnal Spire's temple, and with the great ones when they fall.
Some hunters write their own rules. The Endless Colt is the same gun, always loaded: it never spends a round and never needs reloading. No rite or grave gives it; it is only found in creative mode.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_deal: What it offers, and what it costs in days before the hounds come. Two more hearts, or twenty-five more mana, yours for good: five days. Everything you dropped at your last death that nobody picked up, or a dead pet back on its feet: seven days.

Something rare from its pockets, bullets, embers, shards and the like: ten days. Knowledge: a map to what hides nearby, a Hymnal Spire or a restless grave, or failing that, a book on how to kill the next great thing you have not killed yet: ten days.
The contract tells you whose soul, for what, and how long you have. Keep it. You will need it if you mean to break the deal.
The contract it leaves in your hands
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_debt: On the last day you will hear the dogs. When it falls due, a pack of three to five hellhounds comes for you, wherever you are. Survive the hunt, by killing the pack or lasting two minutes, and the debt is paid.
Die while they are on you and the debt is paid another way. You come back, but not all of you: for three days you are two hearts short and your mana does not return.

Or break it. Burn the contract in a bowl, with holy water, salt and a hellfire ember, and the demon who holds it walks again, angry. Kill it before your time runs out and the contract is void. If it flees its vessel, it comes back another night.
Pass his test and he types your ending. "The End" is the chronicle of your hunt as he saw it: the enemies you beat, what you killed, the deals you made. Use it to read.

The Author's Pen rewrites a small corner of the world. Sneak and use it to choose: the land (the biome around the block you touch), the sky (clear day, rain, storm, clear night) or a creature (into another of its kind; never a great enemy, never a person). Every rewrite takes a long while to dry.

Sam's amulet, worn as a necklace (or in hand without Curios), gives four hearts and shows you the powerful - great enemies and the strange things of this world - through walls, and shines when one is near.
These are given once to each hunter, for their first victory. He will gladly fight you again - another draft - but for you the props department is closed.
The End, the Pen, the amulet
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_mess: At the first dawn after you first bring Azazel down, an angel comes to you: a tired man in a trench coat, with the shadow of wings behind him. He cannot be hurt, and he only wants to talk. He offers you Grace.

Hear him out and he gives you a Vial of Grace and the way to take it in. Turn him away and he comes back three dawns later. Once heeded he no longer comes on his own, but a spell at the bowl can call him again. He never comes to a demon.
An angel in a borrowed trench coat
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_tric: Ever since Lucifer went back in his box, little things have been happening. A candy wrapper by your feet when you haven't eaten any candy. A party hat on a cow. A laugh track somewhere out of sight. A villager quoting a soap opera. A chest that opens and shuts on its own, with nothing missing from it.

None of it breaks anything, takes anything or hurts anyone, and it never happens more than once a day. That is how you know it is not a ghost: it's a Trickster, a pagan god of mischief who plays his jokes on the people who deserve them, and he has noticed you.

Notice three of his pranks and you're on his trail. He can't resist sweets: cook a bait for him in a small circle with three sugar, a honey bottle, cocoa beans, holy oil and a gold nugget, lit with flint and steel.
What he leaves lying around, and what he can't resist
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.trickste: His candy, in a striped wrapper. Eat one and something happens for a little while: always something good, or at least nothing bad. You never know which. That is the point.

His remote control. Point it at a creature and change its channel: it might shrink for a while, turn up in a silly costume, or become another creature of its size altogether. It needs half a minute between uses, and it never works on a great enemy, a named creature or a villager with a trade.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.trophies: Every great one leaves its likeness behind, a little statue to set on a shelf and remember the night by.
Do not get too attached to three of them. War wants Lucifer's, Famine the Darkness's and Pestilence the Chorus's.
Watch the corner of your eye: when the static clears, the channel's number is there, and every channel has its own rule. The banner at the top is his health; the sign under it is the studio's.

CH 2, the Sitcom. A living room, a staircase, doors, and an audience. While the LAUGH sign is lit he can't be touched and plays his gags: pies in the face that blind you, banana peels, a piano from the ceiling (watch for its shadow), extras through the doors. When the sign goes dark he takes more from every blow. Keep hitting him: if nobody touches him for a few seconds, the APPLAUSE sign lights and the audience heals him.

CH 5, Nutcracker! A Japanese game show over a pit of foam: three platforms, red, blue and yellow. Every so often a question appears with three answers, one on each colour. Stand on the right platform before the buzzer: you come away stronger and he is stunned for a moment. Stand on a wrong one, or none, and the trap door or the giant mallet finds you. Fight him between the rounds. The questions are about everything in this book.

CH 7, Dr. Sexy, M.D. A hospital ward with a giant heart monitor. Strike him on the beep (the trace on your screen spikes; the lit band in its middle is your moment) and the blow is critical. The beat quickens as the episode goes on. The defibrillator shocks marked zones of the floor; and nurses, doubles of him in caps, walk to him to heal him: one blow stops a nurse.

CH 9, A Word from Our Sponsor. A white stage with five podiums and five spokesmen, all of him; only the real one casts a shadow of six golden wings. Strike a double and the joke is on you, and the podiums shuffle. They shuffle when you strike the real one too, and every ten seconds. Watch the floor, not the faces.

A human's free will sees through his tricks a little: in the commercial, one more double flickers and fades for them. Demons are cast as the episode's villain and take more from him; an angel's grace drains in his commercial breaks, little brother.
Pale, quick and hungry, they nest in barns and mines and keep to the dark. When they feed a second row of teeth slides down over the first, and a bite leaves you bleeding.

Weakness: only a beheading keeps one down. Kill it with a sword, an axe or a silver machete in your hand, or it goes down and rises again ten seconds later. Dead man's blood (used on it, or smeared on a blade held in your other hand) stuns it cold. Brew it from glass bottles, rotten flesh, a bone and redstone.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.vitality: Every great enemy you outlive makes you harder to kill. The first time each of them falls, everyone who fought it gains two hearts of health for good; the Trickster, who was only playing, gives one. Dying does not take them back.
By the time you knock on the Author's door you will carry twenty-five more hearts than you started with. You will need every one.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.0: A man in a red suit with a sword at his hip, who makes neighbours kill each other for fun. Once Lucifer has fallen, call him in a great circle with iron swords, demon blood and gunpowder, lit with flint and steel.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.1: He lays a battlefield over the arena: trenches, wire, craters. His sword comes in combos he shows you first. Raise a shield just as a blow lands and he staggers: for three seconds he takes half again as much.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.2: Then his four standards rise. Every blow he takes and every standard left standing makes him angrier, faster and harder-hitting; break them. And he gets into your head: for a while every other hunter looks like a demon, and mirages walk the field, some hostile, some innocent. The innocent never strike and kneel where they stand. Hit an innocent or a friend and the blow comes back on you.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.3: At the end he mounts his red horse and charges across the field, sweeping his sword, setting the trenches alight.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.werewolf: By day a lean, unshaven man who keeps to himself. At night his bones crack and he turns into a hulking wolf with yellow eyes, strongest under a full moon.
Weakness: silver, and only silver, ends it. Anything else drives it off at the last; it flees, licks its wounds and comes back whole.

power.supernaturalcraft.fire_immunity.de: Fire and lava do not burn you.
power.supernaturalcraft.first_blade.desc: The First Blade answers its Knight: it strikes half again as hard in your hand.
power.supernaturalcraft.healing_touch.de: Two fingers to the brow of what you look at (or your own): heals four hearts and cures poison and wither. A demon burns instead.
power.supernaturalcraft.host_squad.desc: A captain and four soldiers of the Host answer you for a minute: they follow you, fight what you fight and hunt demons.
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_edge.desc: Your demon-bane weapons strike a fifth harder against anything supernatural.
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_mana.desc: 25 more mana for each rank, as every road gives. (Every human's rites already cost a quarter less and allow longer to recite.)
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_sense.des: You feel the supernatural within 24 blocks: it is marked for you.
power.supernaturalcraft.kill_regen.desc: Every kill heals you two hearts.
power.supernaturalcraft.light_lance.desc: A lance of light thrown where you look; it strikes hard.
power.supernaturalcraft.possess.desc: Ride a creature for 20 seconds: it fights for you while you wait inside it, untouchable.
power.supernaturalcraft.smite.desc: A palm to the face of what you look at: holy fire through the eyes. A lesser demon does not survive it.
power.supernaturalcraft.smoke.desc: Pour out as smoke and rush up to 12 blocks where you look, untouchable on the way. Not while held by a trap.
power.supernaturalcraft.summon_hound.des: A bound hellhound fights at your side for a minute.
power.supernaturalcraft.telekinesis.desc: Seize what you look at; it hangs before you. Cast again to hurl it where you look.
power.supernaturalcraft.teleport.desc: Blink up to 16 blocks where you look, in a flutter of unseen wings. Not while held by a trap.
power.supernaturalcraft.throne.desc: Every creature within 12 blocks is brought to its knees for 8 seconds.
power.supernaturalcraft.true_form.desc: For 10 seconds light pours out of you: everything near that sees it is blinded, and demons burn.
power.supernaturalcraft.wings.desc: Flight with stamina, as Michael's Grace gives the Seraph Wings, with no wings to wear.
power.supernaturalcraft.yellow_eyes.desc: A Prince's eyes. From this rank you need neither food nor sleep.
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.amara_wel: What weakens Amara while it burns?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.angel_fir: What fire does an angel fear?
Whose blood forges the Key to the Cage?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.chorus_we: In what weather is the Broken Chorus woken?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.colt_bull: How many chambers has the Colt?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.colt_roun: How many Colt rounds does one rite forge?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.cracked_k: What does Lucifer leave behind if he wins?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.darkness_: When can the Darkness be called?
What comes for you when a deal falls due?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.deal_seal: How is a crossroads deal sealed?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.death_clo: What winds your clock back against Death?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.death_rin: Win or lose, what does Death give back?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.famine_fo: What happens to food you eat near Famine?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.first_dem: Who was the very first demon?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.ghost_res: How is a ghost laid to rest for good?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hellhound: What shows a hellhound for what it is?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.host_capt: What breaks the ranks of the Host of Heaven?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.human_fre: What does a hunter who stays human keep?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hymn_note: How many notes wake the Broken Chorus?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.last_seal: Who was the last of the sixty-six seals?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.lilith_li: What should stand between you and Lilith's light?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.lucifer_l: What is Lucifer's last face before the end?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.metatron_: What do you write in a book to call Metatron?
Which of these is one of Metatron's Words?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.michael_a: What does Michael ask you for?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.michael_t: Where does Michael's true form stand up?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.pestilenc: What is the only thing that takes Pestilence's flies?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.salt_line: What can never cross a line of salt?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.starting_: How much mana does a hunter start with?
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.amara.hint: Under the eclipse, draw a void circle and wake the Darkness with a nether star.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.amara.name: Amara
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_1.hint: Receive Grace by day in the Overworld: the Vial of Grace, two holy water and four gold, with an Angel Blade to raise it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_1.name: Lesser Angel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_2.hint: Ascend with a Damned Contract, three choir shards and the Seraph Wings: your own wings will carry you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_2.name: Seraph
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_3.hint: By day, give up Lucifer's Grace and an Archangel Blade to become an archangel.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_3.name: Archangel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_4.hint: Usurp the Host: Michael's Grace and a Fallen Star, with Michael's Lance to command them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_4.name: General of the Host
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.ascension.hint: Forge the first Ascension Shard by night (demon blood, embers, salt, quartz; an amethyst lights it). The great enemies leave the rest: raise your weapon and Hunter's Gear at the Hellforge, one tier at a time.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.ascension.name: Ascension
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel.hint: Draw a great circle in blood chalk with lit black candles, offer demon blood, sulfur and salt by night, and call the Yellow-Eyed Demon.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel.name: Azazel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel_blood.h: The Yellow-Eyed Demon bleeds when he falls. Gather what he leaves behind.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.black_eyes.hin: Demons walk the night with black eyes. Kill one and take its blood.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bags.hint: Mix a hex bag: hide a curse near your enemy, or carry a ward to keep demons off you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bags.name: A Bag in Hand
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bind_bani: Learn to hold a creature to the bowl, or to send demons, hounds and ghosts back where they came from.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_blood_via: Use an empty bottle on someone to draw their blood, or on the air to draw your own. The smoke follows blood.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bowl.hint: Hammer copper around a little gold into a spell bowl, and set it down where you mean to work.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bowl.name: A Bronze Bowl
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_concealme: Learn to hide from demons, angels, hounds and spirits. Never from the great ones.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_first_spe: Fill the bowl with what a page asks for, light it, and recite the words without stumbling.
Learn to bind a curse into a pouch, or a ward against demons.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_liquids.h: Every spell wants its liquids: water, holy water, demon blood, a vial of someone's blood, honey.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_locate.hi: Learn to send smoke after what you seek: a person, a pet, a grave, a spire.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_page.hint: The words are written on spell pages: demons carry them, old chests hide them, librarians sell them and graves give them up.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_page.name: Spell Pages
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_pet_colla: Stitch a collar from leather, string and an iron nugget and put it on a pet you have tamed.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_purificat: Learn to cleanse curses, possession and restless spirits, and to break a crossroads deal.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_revive_pe: Learn to call a fallen pet back by its collar.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_salt_and_: Now you can see the dead: find a restless one's bones, salt them and burn them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_second_si: Learn to see what hides: ghosts, hellhounds, hex bags tucked away.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_summon_cr: Learn the words that bring a crossroads demon to you. Think twice before you say them.
Arm the spire's choir altar with the Shattered Hymn and ring its bells. Listen for the wrong note.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.chuck.hint: When you are ready, tell him. He will test you, chapter by chapter, and write your ending.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.chuck.name: The Author
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.crossroads_of_: Every hunter is human, and free. Heaven may call, Hell may bargain, or you may stay what you are and climb the hunter's ranks.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.death.hint: Offer him the three rings in a great circle and wake it with the Soul Scythe. Keep hitting him: your clock is running.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.death.name: Death
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_1.hint: Let the hounds take a soul bound to the crossroads and rise from it a demon, or ask the demon to make you one.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_1.name: Crossroads Demon
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_2.hint: By night in the Overworld: Azazel's blood, a choir shard and two demon blood make a Prince of Hell.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_2.name: Prince of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_3.hint: Take the Mark of Cain: the Angel Tablet and two demon blood, with the First Blade to raise it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_3.name: Knight of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_4.hint: Usurp the throne on the dais of Lucifer's Cage: a Fallen Star and Michael's Grace.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_4.name: King of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.devils_trap.hi: Bind demon blood, salt, paper and red dye in a binding circle to paint a devil's trap.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.eclipse.hint: Darken the sun: crying obsidian, black dye, an ender eye and demon blood in a great circle, by day.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.eclipse.name: The Eclipse
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.famine.hint: Rotten flesh, bread, wheat and salt in a great circle. Don't eat near him; kill his thralls before he does.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.famine.name: Famine
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.find_the_autho: With every great enemy beaten, a page falls at your feet. Cast its spell in the bowl: it draws a map to a cabin very far away.
Hold all four rings, each won from its Horseman.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hint: After Lucifer, somebody starts playing harmless pranks. Notice three, cook his bait in a small circle, then lay holy oil, cake and sugar by night and wake it with the bait. Optional: nothing else needs him.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.name: The Trickster
He leaves one piece of his armour each time he falls. Beat him four times to wear it whole.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grace.hint: An archangel's grace spills when Lucifer dies. Claim it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grace.name: Lucifer's Grace
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.hint: Bind a grimoire and fill its pages with the sigils you find.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.name: The Grimoire
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.heeded_the_cal: After your first victory over Azazel, Heaven sends a messenger at dawn. Hear him out and take the Vial of Grace.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hell.hint: Reforge the cracked Key, then open a rift into Hell: a void circle by night, or a great circle in the Nether.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hell.name: Highway to Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hellfire_ember: Hold a demon in a devil's trap and exorcise it with salt and holy water in a blood circle. Keep the ember it leaves.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.henry.hint: At dawn after Lucifer falls, a man in a fedora comes calling. Hear Henry Winchester out, and take the key.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.henry.name: The Men of Letters
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.holy_water.hin: Lay water bottles and salt in a small circle around the altar and light it to consecrate holy water.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_1.hint: Swear the hunter's oath at the altar: a Colt bullet, four salt, two holy water and a silver machete. Only a human sworn to no side may take it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_1.name: Hunter
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_2.hint: By night, keep the veteran's vigil with what is left of Lilith and of Metatron: their trophies.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_2.name: Veteran
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_3.hint: Become a legend of the road: the four Horsemen's rings and a Fallen Star on the altar.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_3.name: Legend
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hymnal_spire.h: Turn a map into a hymnal map in a small circle and follow it to a spire high in the mountains.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.key_to_the_cag: By night, forge Azazel's blood, hellfire embers, gold and a nether star in a great circle.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.last_seal.hint: Lilith is the last seal. Take it from her when she breaks.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.last_seal.name: The Last Seal
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_aspiran: Beat Lucifer, then wait for dawn. Henry Winchester will offer you the Legacy: take the key.
Follow Henry's map to the stone hut, open the vault door with the key and go down to the library.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_case_cl: Solve cases for field notes and cursed artifacts. Identify an artifact at a desk before you trust it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_first_c: Talk to Henry by the war room's map table and ask for a case. Read the file, follow the map.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_initiat: Finish five pieces of research at the desks. Kill as a member to gather field notes.
Seventy pieces of research, of five kinds. The Aquarian Star lets you run one more at once.
Thirty-five pieces of research, of at least four kinds. Henry's own case is yours.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_ring.hi: The order's ring comes with the rank of Initiate: carry it and research runs faster.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_scholar: Fifteen pieces of research, of at least three kinds.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_shapesh: Anyone could be one. Silver, Second Sight or the Spellwright's Spectacles show it for what it is.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_vampire: A nest in a barn or a mine. Dead man's blood stops one; only taking its head keeps it down.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_werewol: A man by day, a wolf by night. Bring silver, or it will only run away to heal.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lilith.hint: With Azazel dead, call the first demon by night: demon blood, hellfire embers, bones and paper in a great circle.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lilith.name: Lilith
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.hint: Lay the Last Seal, demon blood, embers and holy water in a great circle by night and turn the Key to the Cage.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.name: Lucifer
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer_uncage: Bring the four rings and the Key to the dais of the Cage in Hell. Put him back in the box.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.metatron.hint: With the Chorus silenced, write his name in a book, lay it in a great circle with choir shards, holy water and feathers by night, and he will answer.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.metatron.name: Metatron
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.michael.hint: By day, offer the Angel Tablet and the Seraph Wings in a great circle and wake it with an angel blade. Never give him your yes lightly.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.michael.name: Michael
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.pestilence.hin: A fermented spider eye, mushrooms and clotted blood in a great circle. Drink his antidote, burn his flies.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.raphael.hint: With War, Famine and Pestilence beaten, wait for a thunderstorm. In a grace circle lay two holy oils, a lightning rod, a glistering melon, a golden apple and two feathers, and wake it with an angel blade. Optional: nothing else needs him.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.raphael.name: Raphael
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.rituals.hint: Raise a ritual altar and chalk a circle around it. Every rite starts there.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.rituals.name: The Ritual Altar
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.salt.hint: Every hunt starts with salt. Dig rock salt out of the stone and keep some on you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.salt.name: Salt
Find where a ghost's bones lie, salt them and burn them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.shattered_hymn: Search the spire for a Shattered Hymn, or ink one in a great circle with a feather.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.soul_bound.hin: At the crossroads, tick "Bind my soul" before you seal a deal, or wish to be made one of them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_author.hin: Follow the map to the cabin at the end of the world and talk to the man at the typewriter.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_colt.hint: Lucifer falls with the gun that can kill anything. Pick it up; its rounds are forged by night.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_colt.name: The Colt
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.war.hint: Swords, gunpowder and demon blood in a great circle, lit with flint and steel. Parry, break his standards, trust no demon.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.war.name: War
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.wings_of_heave: Wear the Seraph Wings and take in Michael's Grace: they will carry you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_bowl.hint: Every deal starts at a spell bowl. Cast your first spell.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_bowl.name: Words of Power
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_break.hint: Purification can break a deal: holy water, the contract, salt and a hellfire ember. The demon will come back angry.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_break.name: Breaking the Deal
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_damned_cont: The demon wants paper it can sign: occultists carry damned contracts, Lilith keeps them, Crowley's cells hide them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_deal.hint: By night, fill the bowl with demon blood, a bone, grave dirt, a daisy and the contract, say the words, and choose a wish.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_deal.name: Sealed with a Kiss
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_debt_paid.h: Survive the hunt, or kill the demon before the debt falls due. Die, and they take what they came for.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_hounds.hint: When the debt falls due, the hounds come for you. You will not see them coming.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_hounds.name: When the Hounds Come
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_summoning.h: Find the spell page that teaches the crossroads summoning.
rule.supernaturalcraft.gravity_inverted: And the sky became the floor.
rule.supernaturalcraft.light_hurts: And the light was not good.
rule.supernaturalcraft.unknown: And nothing changed. Or did it?

Should the hounds come for you and take you, you will not lose what you were owed: you will rise one of us.
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.hint: Choose a wish. Mind the term.
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.0: "Everybody wants something. Let's not pretend you're the exception."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.1: "Ten years used to be standard. Times are hard, darling."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.2: "Relax. Nobody reads the fine print anyway."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.3: "You called me. I'd hate to think I dressed up for nothing."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.4: "Your soul for your heart's desire. Fair's fair."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.5: "Tick tock. The dogs get restless when I wait."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.nothing: "I've got nothing you want. Imagine that."
screen.supernaturalcraft.henry.name: Henry Winchester
screen.supernaturalcraft.michael.ask.bod: "Let me in. You'll feel what I feel: the whole of Heaven, behind one sword."
screen.supernaturalcraft.recitation.hint: Type the words. Accents and spaces are optional; Esc abandons.
screen.supernaturalcraft.research.empty: Nothing on the board. Bring field notes, and come back.
screen.supernaturalcraft.research.missin: You don't carry all of it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.banishing.desc: Drawn in blood: an angel struck by it is flung far away and loses its Grace; a lesser angel is sent back to Heaven.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bind.desc: Holds a demon as a devil's trap would; hobbles anything else. Burns demon blood.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bind.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bolt.desc: A thrown sigil that flies straight and breaks on the first thing it meets.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bolt.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.burst.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.echo.desc: The spell repeats itself a moment later.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.echo.source: Lucifer's defeat leaves its page. Only Lucifer's Grace lets a hunter read it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.empower.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.exorcise.desc: Agony to demons. A trapped demon is cast out entirely. Burns salt.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.exorcise.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.extend.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.formula.desc: A formula the Men of Letters worked out from %s: the same working, other numbers.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.formula.source: Your own research at a desk in the bunker.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.frost.desc: Slows and freezes. Turns still water to ice.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.frost.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellfire.desc: Burns flesh. Burns a pinch of sulfur.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellfire.source: Slain demons' pages, and the cells of Crowley's Corridors in Hell.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.mend.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.repel.desc: Hurls the target away from you.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.repel.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.reveal.desc: Strips invisibility, outlines the target and unmasks illusions.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.reveal.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.smite.desc: Holy force. Twice as hard against demons and the dead.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.smite.source: Known from the start (a grimoire teaches it). Lucifer Uncaged drops a page.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.touch.desc: Whatever is within arm's reach. Helpful spells fall back on yourself.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.touch.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.ward.desc: A circle at your feet that keeps working and stops hostile projectiles.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.ward.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.widen.desc: Spreads the effect over an area.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.widen.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.choru: A face of the Chorus sings
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.chuck: An old enemy is written in ink
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.host_: A soldier of the Host murmurs
A soldier of the Host burns out
A soldier of the Host is hurt
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.hunte: Hunters step out of the light
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.item.general: A wing of light takes the blow
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.ambi: Raphael breathes, the storm with him
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.arri: Raphael comes down in a bolt

subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.snap: Fingers snap, and the air bursts
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.death.su: "I was a good son. I did everything He asked."
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase2.s: The Host of Heaven takes the field.
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase5.s: The vessel burns away. The Sword of Heaven stands.
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase6.s: His halo breaks. He will not yield.
His lance, his grace, and a piece of his armour are yours.
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.death.su: Raphael falls, and leaves his wings burnt on the floor
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase1.s: Raphael, archangel of the Lord, has come down to finish it
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase2.s: His garrison holds him up: cut the threads
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase3.s: The roof is gone, and the sky is his
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.abyssal_shard: Rock from the walls of the Pit, cold as the Cage.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet: The word of God, cut in stone. It still burns.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet.u: Use: rewrites your story; healed whole, every harm undone (2 min)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.antidote_vial: Cures the plague; none for 15 s
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.aquarian_star: One more research desk at once while you carry it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.archangel_blad: Use: smite everything before you (%s mana)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.ascension_shar: At the Hellforge, beside what it raises
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.authors_pen: Rewrites a small corner of the world. Each rewrite takes a while to dry.
